items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well sure that's right, that's when Sheik was talking about that same group.

ctx.x: mind if there's anything else that you think would be of interest. I'm sure there would be. But I didn't finish telling you about it from these shows all the way down up until now. Well I came back to town after getting away from the rabbit for the show. Came back home, stayed around three years and three years later I went out with the Clyde Beatty Circus. Oh yeah, you were a family. Yeah, I went out with Clyde Beatty Circus, that was last year. I've done seven months with him and everything was real nice out…
Well sure that's right, that's when Sheik was talking about that same group.

Yeah, my own band out there and everything was real nice. Yeah, I forgot about the name, I forgot the name of it. Before I went out there with him, well I played around here with different bands. I played with Paul Barbraham, made an album with him. Yeah, I remember that. Good time jazz. I remember some time back I played a couple of jobs with Pap Celestine before he died.
